reviews.text: Awesome
Quite professional and well-organized
We are happy to receive your 5-star rating, Josie!
Online appointment was easy. Office visit was quick, professional and efficient.
The entire staff to include the veterinarian treated our pet is if it were their very own.  The level of care and love they have for fur babies is unmatched!!
Quick and easy, thanks! We live Dr Smeltzer and the team, they provide great compassionate care!
Love the staff and love Dr Eric! He’s so good with my Liesel! The techs are so thoughtful and good with my pup! It’s all about her comfort!!
Your positive feedback is appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience with us.
Your review is appreciated. We are grateful for your trust in O'Connor Road Animal Hospital's care.
Thank you for sharing your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital. We genuinely appreciate your feedback.
We're overjoyed to hear about your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
Your feedback is incredibly valuable. Thank you for sharing your experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
I HONESTLY expected higher costs.  You guys are EXTREMELY nice, on schedule and professional.
Everyone is so helpful and kind
Great care and service for our new granddog Shelby.
My dogs love Dr. Schmeltzer. He has been the most thorough and gentle vet we’ve ever had. We moved away for a few years and were happy to come back to have him taking care of them again!
Thank you for your review. We are pleased to hear about your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
Thank you for sharing your 5-star rating. Your trust in O'Connor Road Animal Hospital means a great deal to us.

OConnor Road Animal Hospital did not disappoint! Recently moved to the area and was in need of a new vet. Tried-out North Star 410 Animal Hospital and was not satisfied with the care there; I had to ask the vet tech twice to speak to the Dr for a hands-on assessment. Here at O'Connor Road not only did I receive a hands-on assessment in front of me, but my concerns about my animals weight was addressed right then and there. Dr. Schmeltzer was kind, funny, and professional and him and his staff did not make me feel embarrassed or ashamed of my dog-reactive Belgian Malinois. They were more than accommodating for me to make sure the lobby was clear and I did not feel rushed at all for my appointment, despite talking in length multiple times to the vet techs and Dr. Overall, very satisfied with my care here and I plan on being a long-term client! It was a bonus that they are affordable; A full blood panel was only in the $200's when I have been quoted $800-1,000 at VCA Animal Hospitals prior to the switch.
The staff is great and the Vet is even better. Pricing was very reasonable. I feel like they actually care.

The vet assistant, Natalie, was a breath of fresh air in the way she handled my Heeler. I was quite nervous going in, but by the time we left, my Savannah had made a new friend. And, as always, Dr.  Zengler and the rest of the staff were amazing. I have taken several pets to O"Connor Road Animal Hospital over the years, and I have NEVER had a bad experience. I have had bad experiences at other vet clinics. I am a forever patient-parent at this place, thanks to my neighbor across the street's recommendation!
Thank you for your wonderful feedback. Your support means a great deal to our team at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
Thank you for the 5-star rating. Your trust in O'Connor Road Animal Hospital means a great deal to us.
Best ever vet clinic!  Their personal and professional care has kept our two cats healthy and happy!  Very well done.

So today, I went in for quite an emergency.  I told the staff i will do anything to wait for a doctor.  They said they have only 1 doctor working on a Monday!!!  They used to have many doctors working all the time!!!  The doc who was there has known me and my animals for years!!!  I practically begged the manager to let me wait for the doc and she just kept telling me no. I feel a huge betrayal of trust and loyality!  My sweet baby needs medication and they wouldnt see me even for a minute.  Ever since they got this new manager, amazing docs have left the practice and I see why!!! I used to recommend to all of my friends to go there.  I have even paid for my friends before because I wholeheartly trusted the care that was given to my animals.  I have been going there for almost 20 years and this is the service I get!!!  I will never be going back!
We're delighted to hear about your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital. Thank you for your feedback.

This is my go to for my dogs since 2013. Great staff. Very friendly. They don't judge you if you hadn't bring them in for their annual exam (like me I take them in once every few years).

Also the staff are compassionate. I had taken my first dog here when he died and they were able to bring him back- unfortunately my dog had other plans. Less than a year my other dog died and they weren't able to save him. But the compassion I received from the staff just solidified me wanting to keep going back to them.

I love how the doctors tell you how it is and tell you what is highly recommended and needed to make sure my dogs are able to live a long happy life. I also love how they don't try to upsell anything to you. They tell you "hey, you might want to consider this (product) for your pet" but ultimately they know it's up to us as pet parents.

Yesterday we took our 9 yr old four legged son in for his annual check up and get his vaccination. After wards he still wanted to be around the vet. All of their staff is professional, and I would highly recommend them. We have been using them for the past 7 years.
Everyone was very friendly and knowledgeable! Thank you so much for helping my dog feel better!

Update: I have to buy my own prescription bottles with syringe adapters because they don't have it for the medicine I get the majority of the time. I shouldn't have to make up for their inadequacies, buying basic supplies that they should have.
Phone hold times are ridiculous. I get my prescriptions in less than 2 days at the other two vets mentioned. Not here. Update: June 2025 I was given 300 mg capsules instead of 100 mg capsules which would have overdosed my dog if I hadn't looked up the numbers on the pills online and not given it to her.Still one of the most poorly run offices. Outside of the vets, the majority of the staff is incompetent and unethical. I asked for an apology, that's when I received it. My bf loves Dr. Schmeltzer. Dr. Schmeltzer has worked there around 15 years. We go to Community Pet Health most of the time, now.
I've been coming here 15 years and it goes downhill every year along with getting more expensive. It was originally run by a vet but was taken over by a corporation, NVA. Phone line too frequently isn't working or they are having 2 hr office meetings during office hours. My bf likes Dr Schmeltzer. He is the ONLY reason we had stayed. I recommend Community Pet Health, they are very efficient and competent. The wait times in the lobby and room, with an appt, are a fraction of what they are at O'Connor and they fill my prescriptions the same day. No 24 to 48 hr wait. I also recommend North Star 410 as they have extended hours Thursday through Sunday.

I had an amazing experience at this pet hospital. The entire team was so kind, caring, and professional. They took the time to explain everything in great detail, answered all of my questions, and truly made me feel comfortable with Hunter’s care. You can tell they genuinely care about their patients and their owners.

I also really appreciate that they’ve been following up with me every day to check on Hunter. That level of compassion and dedication means so much. They were also right on time for our appointment, which made the whole experience even better.

I highly recommend this pet hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares about your pet. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Hunter!
We deeply respect your positive feedback. Thank you for sharing your experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.

Do not bring your pet here for vaccinations. Especially for annual vaccinations that are required by the county. They do not pay attention to detail or read the room when it comes to the initial assistants coming in to check your animal. very uneducated, unprofessional & very shady billing practices. BEWARE AND GO SOMEWHERE ELSE if you value your animal's well being. Wish i was lying, but will NEVER AGAIN use this for our animals or relatives animals.

Great veterinarians and staff! I’ve trusted them with my dogs ever since I first brought them in. They were incredibly thorough during their initial exams, took the time to answer my questions, and have continued to provide excellent care at every visit. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a caring and knowledgeable veterinary team.
Very nice staff very helpful

Dr. Marin was great with our pet. Very helpful, friendly, communicative, and understanding. Unfortunately, she left and we have another Dr tending to our pet. The staff is friendly, but communication is extremely frustrating! Getting someone to return my messages via phone or text or having them advise me when an RX refill is ready is almost non-existent. And there have been a couple of times I've been placed on hold for over 10 minutes. I don't know what they're doing they forget they placed you on hold without even knowing the reason for your call.
Staff is warm welcoming, professional, courteous & extremely helpful. You are greeted immediately and attended to swiftly as they can
Thank you for your review and for choosing O'Connor Road Animal Hospital for your pet's care needs.
We genuinely admire your positive feedback. Thank you for choosing O'Connor Road Animal Hospital!

I am happy with the staff and doctor at O’Conner Road Animal Hospital. Luna’s exam and issues were taken care of in a friendly, timely, and professional manner. I am glad to have found this new facility for health care for our cats!

Have been taking our pets here for 25 years. Although we’ve always had great service the staff turnover seems to cause a lot of confusion lately or so it seems. Always ask if you can get prescriptions at an outside pharmacy and ask for ways to reduce costs. The vets are amazing at helping out with this.
Thank you for your review. We appreciate your feedback.
Your review is appreciated. Thank you for sharing your experience with us.
I took my dog to O'Connor Road Animal Hospital for my annual exam and a health certificate. They were professional, helpful, and dealt gently with my dog.
Helpful, caring staff. Best vet experience yet. Will continue to take my little adopted family over there for health care!

Not happy with customer service.  They said one on my dogs needed wellness check.  I explained my mother is in hospice care and it's going to very hard for me to get there.  I asked them to check to see if my other dog needed it also.  They said no.   A few weeks later I was told Rabbies was going to expire needed to be done.  I asked about other dog, they said no.  Last week I delayed my trip back a day and called to make the appointment.  I asked again and said I cold bring both.  They said no.   The following day, I'm driving to see my mom and get a text saying it's time to make an appointment for my other dogs wellness check.  WOW how does that happen

STAY AWAY FROM THIS CLINIC 👎👎👎👎

I brought in a stray cat and made it clear from the beginning that it was a stray. The clinic knew stray cats are at higher risk for Feline Leukemia, yet they performed over $550 in services and tests before finally running a Leukemia test. Needless to say, the Leukemia test was the very last test they performed—and it came back positive.

When I questioned why the Leukemia test wasn't done first, the response I received was essentially that the clinic has expenses and overhead to cover. That answer told me everything I needed to know this clinic prioritized billing over common sense and proper guidance. One of the worst VETS I have been to. Then they  charged $130 to put the cat down when that test should’ve been done first and then put the cat down probably would’ve ran 250 but no I walked out of there paying big bucks. Good luck if you use them the worst.

It was our first time at the clinic, and I was really preoccupied with the services my cat would receive and the pricing. Thankfully, all my worries disappeared the moment we arrived. Everyone was incredibly kind and welcoming, and the pricing was very reasonable. They treated a nasty ear infection my cat had that was even causing his eyes to shake, and thanks to their care, he’s doing great now. Kaze and I are so grateful for the compassion and excellent treatment we received.
It's a good clinic the only thing I don't like they always have a different Vetenarian. I now just ask for the same Vet that checks my dog.
This visit to reassess the leg injury on ourv8byear old female Mastiff. Dr. Schmetzer , the techs and front office staff are very professional and engaging.

Had some litter stray kittens with crusty eyes they were able to see the kittens the same day and prescribe ointment for them a day later they are much improved very happy with the care the kittens received
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We're grateful for your review.
We're honored to receive your 5-star rating, Vicky! Thank you for choosing O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
They are amazing!!! Thank yall so much for taking care of my Honey Bun Girl!!! 🩷🩷🩷 …
Dr ziegler is awesome

OMG THEY SAVED MY MISS KITTY’S LIFE 😭👏

I am very grateful for the staff, and doctor here! They got me in for an emergency appointment same day, and saved my 15 year old cats life!

Very clean, professional facility. Knowledgeable staff. GREAT DOCTOR AND TECH!!!

And at a time when I really didn’t think I was going to be able to afford the proper car for Miss Kitty, they made sure everything we did stayed well within my budget!

Very affordable!

I won’t ever go to another veterinarian clinic!

I highly recommend them!
Thank you 🙏😎👍
Thank you for your review. We appreciate your feedback.

Great visit with  Dr  Marina and great attention to Sidney. The Dr was very informative ..
Very pleased with office staff as well.
Your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital is greatly appreciated. Thank you for sharing your feedback, Kerstin.
Love going to your hospital, the staff is very nice and the doctors are very explanatory when I need questions answered! 😁
The customer service was very professional and compassionate. They helped me a great deal, and it was quick; they only charged me $25 to put my old dog to sleep.
OConner Pet hospital is a great place to take your animals they are very professional and friendly great doctors and staff I recommend them to anyone that Love your pet

We had a great experience here. I was able to get my dog seen the same day I called and was given an action plan to get him feeling better. He ended up needing to be neutered and they fit me in quickly. Thank you very much to Dr. Ray and staff for taking care of Bane. ❤️ Everyone was friendly and helpful!
Always outstanding service by staff and vets
Thank you for your review. We are privileged to have provided excellent care for your pet at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
Everyone there was very helpful and good with the animals.
As always my experience was wonderful!!!  Penelope and I thank you!
We're sorry to hear about your experience. Please contact us at (210) 657-5099 to discuss further.

I had my senior dog establish her care here. Since then we have had a few visits and a dental procedure that required anesthesia. I was kept updated during the surgery and could tell they took great care of her. I will definitely be recommending this vet to friends and also recommend their paw plans!
My daughter took our fur baby in and as always was treated very well, making sure he received all his shots and keep him up to date!
Nice facility w friendly staff & amazing facility

Thank you for seeing us and for giving us grace 😭 Traffic was really bad even when we left earlier to get to the appointment. We really needed this appointment as a requirement for more paperwork for travel. We appreciate your help from the Front Desk to the tech and Dr. Schmeltzer! They’re a great team! …
Your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital is greatly appreciated. Thank you for your feedback.

I am extremely thankful for the amazing care my dogs have received all these 15 years. I will be forever thankful for all the care my 12.5 year old Armani received and for the current care my baby Chanel is receiving. Doctor Schmeltzer is great and cares for our furry babies. I recommend this veterinarian hospital to everyone. The people in the front desk provide a fabulous customer service and I really appreciate that. I moved to Austin in 2014 and I could not change doctor Schmeltzer or this hospital. I don’t mind driving 1 hour to San Antonio because everyone at Oconnor road animal hospital are simply the best. Chanel and I thank you very much for the amazing professional  care and dedication you always provide.

Always a pleasant visit with any of the vets in this office! It's easy to make appointments and it's never a long wait to get an appointment. They will break down all charges for you before proceeding so there are no surprises when it comes time to pay. They treat my pets with love and care. Highly recommend!
Your positive feedback means everything to our team. We appreciate you choosing O'Connor Road Animal Hospital for your pet's care.

Our dog is very sick and they were excellent in doing lab work to find out what's wrong and prescribe medications and return for followup visits to check his lab work to make sure the medication is  working. Every one we have had contact with has been excellent to work with and seemed very concerned of his condition.
Most Excellent service. Luke skywalker and I, will miss all the staff and the veterinarians and everyone that makes  this place amazing. Thank you again

I had to find another veterinarian hospital to start taking my princess Wiggles to.  So I found O'Connor Road Animal Hospital and it is great.  My princess is not scared to go there.  Dr Gamble is so wonderful with her.  She cleaned her teeth and did a wonderful job. The techs are all wonderful and friendly.  I highly recommend this place to anyone. Dr Zingler is a great Doctor and wiggles loves going there. Great service. I highly recommend them.

I called O’Connor Animal Hospital and was able to get a same day appointment for my 8-year old Pitt bull. The staff was friendly and professional and (best of all) the veterinarian Dr. Eric Scmeltzer was able to put my dog at ease immediately, my pittie was quite taken with this veterinarian! I would highly recommend this clinic and will definitely return in the future.
Staff and Doctor was very nice, answered questions and kind.
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback.
We're utterly delighted to hear about your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital. Thank you for your wonderful 5 star review.
Very satisfying service
Staff was great and took wonderful care of my fur babies!
Great service as usual. Wonderful team.

The Vet, Vet Tech, and front staff were all very nice and helpful. Dr. Ray explained everything to me and even called me afterwards to go over labs we were waiting on. Excellent experience. My pup loves going there.
4.0 the best.
Baylor loves the team of Vet's here at O'Connor Road Animal hospital, he gets excited at the traffic signal to the clinic. They're very respectful of the pets needs and the parents budget.🐾

Dr. Zengler and Crystal are great. I was able get my pup, Kenzo, worked in on short noticed. Thanks for putting up with his overly hyper energy.
The clinic runs efficiently. I highly recommend the crew at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital. Your pet's health is in excellent hands!
They were extremely helpful and kind to my old man Rudy. They fit me in last minute on a Saturday and took great care of him and had us on our way quickly. Thank you for all your help!
The O'Connor animal, they always go to my pets. So I'm very happy with the doctors and all that technicians are very good

O’Connor Road Animal Hospital is great, in particular the vets. Prices can feel a bit on the higher side, but the location, friendliness, and knowledge of the staff makes being a customer a no brainer. I feel our dogs and cats are truly cared for!
Very professional from Doctor to all of the staff. This the dogs first day home and are moving around, some what slowly, but in good spirit.

My baby was not feeling well and they were able to get her in on the morning I called. I’ve been taking our pets to the office for 9 years.
Everyone has always been kind, courteous and compassionate. Love Dr. Ziggler!

I frequently get same day appointments which gives much relief. The staff is all so attentive and the medical committee seem to all have appropriate capability to diagnose and treat what we sought them for. I do recommend them to all who inquire.
Thank you to the team at O’Connor Road Animal Hospital for squeezing us in when my dog was acting out of the norm and in pain.

Horrible experience. I took my cat there because he wasn’t feeling well and the staff ended up telling me my cat was due for his rabies vaccination and that we can get it done that day. They took my cat to the back and my cat bit one of the employees and they reported him to the city. Now I can’t get my sick cat seen for over a week. I think it was unprofessional how they handled my cat and caused him a lot of distress. As well as not providing me with information on how to help my cat now that he’s in this situation. Also the prices are outrageous they were trying to charge me $700 for the exam, x rays, and blood work.
Great service and very attentive people. Affordable and fast.

This place is unnecessarily over priced. Tried getting a health certificate to travel and was told it was going to be $300 and in order to even book the appointment they wanted half as a down payment. Found another place that did it for less than $100.

Great vet organization. Front office staff goes above and beyond. Vets take the time to listen. Vets also clearly explained treatment options for my dog. My dog was treated well and not stressed out. Nice people! Very professional
Love Occonnor Rd ❤️. Dr Smetler & all the Drs are Great. Front Desk & are sooo helpful!
Difficult to improve on excellence! Keep up the good work! Thank you !
Great staff and very professional Doctors and Assistants! 🙏

Great experience. They had a cute sign in the lobby with my pup’s name. All of the office staff were friendly and helpful. The Vet and Vet tech were very kind and loving to my dog mellow (who wasn’t feeling well). They also offer really great pet insurance which saved me a ton and the top package is priced under $100 monthly and includes dental cleaning. 10/10 experience and our new Vet home. Thank you
The veterinarian who attended us and her staff were very courteous and professional.  Our kitten was badly hurt and they provided us with what was needed to get him healed as soon as possible.

Needed an emergency visit for my pup and they took me in same day, after another clinic referred me to them. They were gentle with my dog who wasn't feeling well and gave me a couple of options to treat him and explained all treatment costs.
The staff and vet were awesome
Been with OConnor Animal Hospital for over 10years and have always had a pleasant experience.
Thanks for the positive feedback, NEERAJ. We deeply respect your kind words about O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
Thank you for your wonderful feedback. We appreciate your input.

We've been very pleased with O Conner so far. They are friendly, caring, and about half the cost of our previous vet in Cibolo. They are thorough but don't foist extra services and expenses on you. I feel all 7 of my fur babies are in good hands with them.
Very good service

I had a kitten get sick all of a sudden . I live near the ORAH and so I stopped in without an appointment or even calling . Very nice at the desk . Knew what was wrong and treated her . Very nice and professional . All the way around . Thank you . And good follow up as well . 5 star
As always, great service at the front desk with wonderful, caring vets
Friendly, efficient, clean and knowledgeable.
Putting my new rescue on their health plan. Great place, close to home, great docs who spend the time you need to ask any questions. Very impressed and look forward to a good relationship!
Great service!
Nice and clean and professional

I had an appointment at 4:30 today, and I called at 4:29 to let them know I needed to move appointment to tomorrow if possible. The receptionist said I would have to pay a no show charge of $75.00 bc I called after 4:30. Well, according to my phone it was before the appointment!!! Not only that, but I was never advised there would be an exam fee charge of $75 if we were no shows or did not contact them prior. This is the last straw. I was going to give them another chance, since the female vet basically let my yorkie die a year ago…but perhaps this was Gods way of making sure I NEVER go back. DONE & DONE. Oh and you won’t be getting the $75 dollars. Jerk.
Thank you for your very generous 5 star review. We're ecstatic to have provided a positive experience for you at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.
Super friendly place to go. I've been going there for about a year and they are awesome

I definitely recommend O'Connor Road Animal Hospital! The staff is friendly and professional, and I always feel my dog is well taken care of. Even though we moved further away, we will continue to use them for all our veterinarian needs.

I have taken my fur babies to O'Connor Road Animal Hospital for almost 20 years now.  I drive across town to go there and I wouldn't go anywhere else! Dr. Smeltzer and the team make the trip worth it.  Over the years we have seen many doctors and technicians, but Dr. Smeltzer is our favorite!  He's so gentle and patient with everyone.  It's very easy to tell that he's passionate about caring for the animals that come to see him. Our most recent visit concerned Maggie and a rash on her shoulders, he suggested a treatment, explained how it would help and how it was ok to use the medication given the time frame it had been since she had had it before.  I appreciate that he took the time to do that and that he felt it was important to do so.  Fantastic experience!

Yuki, my 4yr. old Pekingese went in for a Cytopoint Injection and her heart worm check up. She suffers from seasonal allergies as well as food allergies. This clinic has done an excellent job caring for Yuki. The techs do an excellent job explaining what meds Yuki needs or treatment the Dr. recommends. I highly recommend this location for your PETs medical needs. Thank you for the excellent service that we received today 🐶🐾😃
We are utterly delighted to receive your 5 star review.  Thank you for choosing O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.

Compassionate ? Check
Kindness ? Check
Patience ? Check
Affordable? Check
Thorough ? Check

I had an emergency and they were so kind from start to finish especially the veterinarian, I wouldn’t still have my ESA pup if it weren’t for her. Thank you a million!! Logan thanks you too ♥️
Thank you for your review. We appreciate your feedback.

You healers were awesome, helping us both my baby was hurt and you guy's provided superb service and price but she still is hurting / limping and I must take her back for x-rays real soon ! Oct 2025 time frame please call me back for services pending and I also will have to register a new family member a cat ? Lol Lilly
We genuinely admire your 5-star rating! Thank you for letting us know.
Great overall service! Treated our cat, Sage, beautifully!

I took my dog to see why she was limping. Dr Aguilar and staff did such a great job treating her and explaining what was wrong and how to get her better that I took my other two dogs. This time it was Dr Marin and staff who did a wonderful job taking care of them and addressing my concerns. I'll be using them from now on. My thanks to all of them!
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback. Thank you for the 5 star review:)
Was great
They are very compassionate and professional. My chee couldn't be saved but they went out of their way to take care of her.
Thank you  for clipping  my baby  boy  Hunters nails
We genuinely admire your 5-star rating! Thank you for choosing O'Connor Road Animal Hospital.

Absolutely wonderful! Brought our barely one year old cat (kitten?) for an urgent same day appointment due to an altercation with one of our other cats, and our regular vet couldn't for us in.
The desk staff were fantastic, friendly and helpful. The vet technician, Maya, was outstanding and I cannot say enough about the care and concern that Dr. Masses showed. Dr. Masses was exceptional, and if I leave my current vet of 30+ years, I will be coming to Dr. Masses.

Top notch facility and always improving the building for the clients. New Wash
tub for grooming the dogs. Doctors and staff are excellent, They really care about about your animals and family...
All of our guys go here!!!! Best Vet in San Antonio 💙 🐈 🐕 …

My mama cat appeared to have been hit by a car and couldn't use her rear leg. The tech took her to the vet very gently and twice came in to give us updates. We were given an estimate of cost for the visit which was less than I had feared but still a lot at the high end possible. It was, after all, an emergency. The vet returned to say Angel's hip had several fractures, but that  was the extent of her damage. Time, staying quiet and some pain control should let her heal. Everyone we saw was caring and calm. My anxiety was relieved and even my pocketbook didn't take too big a hit! I highly recommend both the vets and the staff at the veterinary clinic on O'Connor.

My last vet moved away and the practice was taken over by a group that I was not happy with. They were not as personable or as thorough. But at O'Connor Road Hospital, Dr. Schmeltzer answered all my questions, and kindly addressed an issue my cat had over the phone after the visit. I feel much better knowing my 19-year-old cat is in good hands. I also, liked the neighborhood rooster that hangs out around the office.

We loved Dr Ray she was wonderful with our dogs.
She took a lot of time to explain everything to us.
She really listened to our concerns. We highly recommend her. We traveled far to come to this clinic just to find Dr Ray and we are so thankful we did. Great service and staff !
Daisy was treated with so much love!
We are overjoyed to hear about your positive experience at O'Connor Road Animal Hospital. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

I've been taking my pets here for some time.  I couldn't ask for better service.  There is always room to be seen on the same day and my pets love the attention that the staff gives them.
After 5 years I still recommend these folks.
I love this place. Everyone here is so kind. I wouldn, trade it for a second. You guys ate awesome. Keep up the good work.
The staff were helpful and informative. We’ll return for a check up.

I couldn’t believe how clean this place was considering is a pet place. I was so appreciative when they got my sick fur baby in the same day . The time frame was also surprising I was in and out in 2 hours and paid less then $200 for medication consultation and testing. Thank you
Great service everytime
Outstanding!  Highly recommended
A good vets office. I need to get my cat in ASAP, and they were very accommodating.  They have been treating my dog for his cushings with meds and both my dogs with regular checkup and shots.

I called numerous places for pricing and when I called here they said “ what’s going on with your baby.” It’s not much but it meant something to me because I was stressing on where to take my dog. When I got here it was pleasant, everyone at the front desk , the technicians, the doctors had great customer service . They made sure I knew about pricing before I made any decisions. It was those small things that really mattered.
Staff and Dr Smeltzer were awesome with my dog and also explaining everything. Would highly recommend.
Thank you for your positive feedback, Frances. We genuinely admire your support.

I brought my sweet Tulip (cat) to O'Connor Road Animal Hospital after noticing she had lost weight and stopped eating. From the moment I walked in, I was met with compassion and urgency. They accepted CareCredit, which was a true blessing as I'm on a fixed income, and I am so grateful for that.
Sadly, Tulip was diagnosed with kidney failure, and I had to make the heartbreaking decision to let her go. No one should ever have to go through that moment but Dr. Cheryl Zengler and Crystal were exactly who I needed. Their kindness, empathy, and grace during that time made the unbearable more bearable. I truly believe God guided me to this clinic to help me through this loss.
We never want to play God, but with these amazing women by my side, I was able to make the humane decision for Tulip with peace in my heart. Thank you, from the bottom of my soul, for helping me through one of the hardest moments of my life.

Amazing Dr Garica quickly recognized my pups teeth growing the wrong direction and explained the ball theory and gave us a ball as well . The veterinarian is very insightful, addressed issues and provided solutions . My four pups have an amazing veterinarian here at this duty station highly recommended . Max was so relaxed at the vet he took naps
